sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: [LOGIC] gen:IMO_069_Shape / sh:or third branch / devicePowerSourceIndependentOfMainPower property shape: The conditional branch has no sh:minCount, so the property shape is satisfied when devicePowerSourceIndependentOfMainPower is absent; consequently, an antecedent value of true does not require the independent-power value to be present and true. Required change: Add sh:minCount 1 to the devicePowerSourceIndependentOfMainPower property shape in the true-antecedent branch, while retaining sh:hasValue true and sh:datatype xsd:boolean. | [LOGIC] gen:IMO_069_Shape / sh:or second branch / addedLifeSavingDeviceRequiresPower property shape: This branch requires at least one false value but does not prohibit a simultaneous true value. A multi-valued antecedent containing both false and true can therefore satisfy this false branch without satisfying the required independent-power condition. Required change: Constrain the false-antecedent branch to exclude true values, for example by adding sh:not [ sh:hasValue true ] to that property shape, or remove the redundant branch and retain an equivalent false-or-absent branch.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: [MANDATORY_CONDITION] gen:IMO_069_Shape/sh:or[1]/sh:property[nltl:addedLifeSavingDeviceRequiresPower] and gen:IMO_069_Shape/sh:or[2]/sh:property[nltl:addedLifeSavingDeviceRequiresPower]: Both OR branches require nltl:addedLifeSavingDeviceRequiresPower with sh:minCount 1, so the candidate rejects a ship when the antecedent is absent. The requirement specifies only the implication that when this value is true, the independent power-source condition must be true; it does not make the antecedent itself mandatory. Required change: Remove the unconditional requirement for the antecedent and encode the implication so that an absent antecedent does not violate the shape, while retaining the requirement for nltl:devicePowerSourceIndependentOfMainPower when the antecedent is true.

[CARDINALITY] gen:IMO_069_Shape sh:or branches for nltl:addedLifeSavingDeviceRequiresPower and nltl:devicePowerSourceIndependentOfMainPower: The boolean equality branches use sh:hasValue with only sh:minCount, so a node containing both false and true values for the antecedent can satisfy the false branch without requiring independent power, and a node containing both true and false values for the consequent can satisfy the true branch. The candidate therefore accepts multivalued boolean states that do not conform to the stated scalar conditional. Required change: Add sh:maxCount 1 to the antecedent property shapes in the false and true branches and to the consequent property shape in the true branch, while preserving sh:maxCount 0 for the absent antecedent branch.

[CARDINALITY] gen:IMO_069_Shape/sh:or: The candidate imposes exactly-one cardinality on addedLifeSavingDeviceRequiresPower when it is false or true, and exactly-one cardinality on devicePowerSourceIndependentOfMainPower when the antecedent is true. The requirement specifies only the conditional boolean implication and does not mandate these cardinalities, so valid RDF with additional values can be rejected. Required change: Encode only the implication that a true addedLifeSavingDeviceRequiresPower value requires a true devicePowerSourceIndependentOfMainPower value; remove the unjustified minCount/maxCount restrictions, while retaining datatype and conditional-value checks as applicable.
